title: Require bounded foreground validation and terminal evidence before one-shot worker completion

owned: Claude and Claude2 one-shot runtime environment policy
Repository config, adapter child environment, wakeup rendering, and live-config projection regressions
not_changing: Claude adapter implementation or provider identity, authentication, and quota boundaries
Worker runner cleanup, process groups, leases, or canonical completion authority
Supervisor, runtime JSON, product code, BFF tests, live promotion, cron, or launchers
composes_with: Existing repository-config to live-config projection and exact-runtime promotion

implementation.wakeup_contract: Requires bounded foreground batches and terminal output plus exit status before final, handoff, or task transition; background handles require blocking collection; timeout, killed, and collection states do not pass.
implementation.provider_policy: Both repository Claude provider runtime.env maps set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS to string value 1 while retaining distinct config directories and accounts.
implementation.single_policy_path: The unchanged Claude adapter _spawn_env consumes runtime.env, and unchanged build_live_config deep-copies repository config without incumbent overlay fallback.

non_passing_environment_attempt.result: Interpreter lacked pytest; not counted as executed or passed tests. The repository's existing pytest venv was then used for the terminal runs above.

required_checks: Confirm actual repository config sets the vendor variable for exactly claude and claude2 without merging identities
Confirm mocked adapter launches override a contradictory ambient value through existing runtime.env propagation
Confirm rendered wakeups require terminal output and exit status for owner, reviewer, and closeout dispatches
Confirm live-config projection retains candidate policy and ignores an incumbent contradictory overlay
Confirm no adapter, runner, supervisor, runtime state, product, BFF, launcher, daemon, cron, or live promotion change is present

promotion_boundary: Source delivery is not live policy acceptance. After merge, the existing exact-runtime promotion must pass preflight and a later real one-shot dispatch must provide live spawned-env and bounded terminal-result evidence.
